title: field-provenance-correlation-prober-for-structured-output-regressions
creator: Priya Nair
description: Build a lightweight probing service that correlates per-field structured-output degradations with recent model/config changes by tracking provenance (model version, quantization profile, routing policy, prompt-template, tokenizer flags). The probe should operate inside the existing evals pipeline and generate a ranked list of candidate root causes for a detected quality regression in JSON outputs. Goal: surface actionable hypotheses (e.g., 'kv-cache changes + quantization profile X increased numeric rounding on field price') with confidence scores and example diffs so on-call and PMs can triage faster.
acceptance_criteria: Probe runs as an optional stage in canary and shadow eval flows and produces per-field correlation scores (Spearman + permutation p-value) between recent config/model deltas and observed field-level metric drops
For a flagged regression, UI/alert includes top-3 candidate causes with supporting example pairs and suggested mitigation (rollback, fallback model variant, adjust quantization)

Integration tests cover synthetic regressions introduced by controlled config flips (quantization, kernel selection, prompt prefixing) and the probe achieves >= 80% precision at top-1 for these synthetic cases
Telemetry emitted: cause_score, related_delta_keys, sample_examples (ids), probe_latency, and probe_version; all conform to Console schema and appear in staging dashboard
plan: Design probe data model: field provenance tuples (request_id, field_path, model_version, model_config_hash, prompt_template_hash, tokenizer_flags, timestamp)
Add lightweight instrumentation in eval runner to capture provenance for sample pairs (gold, candidate) and store in s3/staging bucket using compact columnar format

Implement correlation engine: compute per-field change metrics (coverage drop, value-type flips, regex failures) and correlate with delta-timeline of config changes using time-windowed permutation tests
Expose probe output via evals API and wire into Console canary UI as a supplemental panel for structured-output alerts
Create automated synthetic harness that applies controlled config flips to baseline model to validate probe precision/recall
Ship an initial v0 that runs on rollouts with shadow-evals only, iterate after 1 week of real traffic
progress_updates: 2026-02-22: Spike completed to validate provenance capture overhead; added hooks to eval runner to attach model_config_hash and prompt_template_hash to each sample (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/421)
